title: Director Script Segment
description: A single speaker turn in the Acquired Audio Director Script. One object per JSONL line.

chunk_id.description: Chunk group for API call batching (e.g., C01)

speaker.description: Speaker identity — determines cognitive role, not voice

intent.description: What this turn accomplishes in the conversation

delivery.description: ElevenLabs v3 audio tags (max 1-2). Empty string if none.

text.description: The spoken text, rewritten for oral delivery

pause_after_ms.description: Pause after this turn in milliseconds. Prefer punctuation over explicit pauses.

regeneration_note.description: Only present when status=regenerate. Direction for re-generation.

text_hash.description: SHA256 hash of text field for change detection during regeneration

audio_path.description: Path to rendered audio file (populated after TTS generation)
